description.value: A well-serviced BC Parks campground on Highway 97 in the Cariboo, with flush toilets, tap water, and a sani-station; the lake beach, playground, and boat launch are across the highway in a separate day-use area. Good fishing for kokanee, rainbow, and lake trout, with a short self-guided history trail on site.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms this is an active, bookable frontcountry campground on Highway 97 with explicit mentions of tap water, flush toilets, a sani-station, and a picnic shelter in the day-use area. The website explicitly states the nearby Lac La Hache community has a grocery store, gas station, bakery, and restaurants. The OSM phone and email appear to belong to the park operator (Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd.) rather than BC Parks general contact, and neither appears explicitly in the fetched website text, so phone confirmation is null.
concerns: OSM phone (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) appear to belong to the park operator (Shuswap Adams Parks Ltd.) rather than BC Parks; these contact details do not appear in the fetched website content and cannot be independently confirmed.
No civic address recorded in OSM; location is described on the website as 13 km north of the Lac La Hache community on Highway 97.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, active BC Parks campground directly on Highway 97 with 83 sites, potable water, flush toilets, and convenient nearby services — a clear fit for touring cyclists on the Cariboo corridor.

wow_evidence: flush toilets, tap water, and a sani-station ... directly on Highway 97
